title: Complete reproduction of the McGuire-Schlesinger-Williams wire-graph/cutwidth route at the rule-bound constant: liminf C_B2(f_n)/n >= 4.56249767892 for Li's FOCS 2023 sumset-extractor family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. claims: Unscored lemma (read-once program lower bound): by Li's extractor theorem at error 1/8 (Theorem LI, cited with version, statement and hypotheses in proof.md), Lemma HARD gives that for all large n, f_n has at least 2^(n-2) accepting inputs and every accepting rectangle, under every split of the coordinates, has a side of size less than K = n^c_Li; Lemma COUNT then gives that every read-once program computing f_n has more than 2^(n-2)/K^2 edges. Proof: proof.md, Lemmas HARD and COUNT.

Unscored lemma (the rule bound): for every mass vector m over the 123-type cone of proof.md, the matched-edge cost satisfies f(m) <= (S_u + S_v)/(2*pi) <= 2*kappa_E, where kappa_E = (3/(2*pi))*arccos((1+2*sqrt(2))/4); consequently the cone supremum obeys M_123 <= 2*kappa_E. Proof: proof.md, Lemmas EC, STAR and RB; the F table, the 123-type enumeration and the constant are machine-verified in checks.py part 1 and part 2.

Unscored lemma (kernel cutwidth bound): for every xi in (0,1] there is C_xi such that every kernel (simple, triangle-free, 2-connected cubic graph) H on h vertices has cutwidth at most (M_123/2 + xi)*h + C_xi; with the rule bound, at most (kappa_E + xi)*h + C_xi. Proof: proof.md, Theorem A and Corollary A1.

Unscored lemma (certified constant): in exact rational interval arithmetic, sqrt(2) to width < 1e-30, pi to width < 1e-12 (Machin), arccos(mu0) to width < 1e-17 by bisection against rigorous cos Taylor enclosures, giving kappa_E in [0.14035096863582366, 0.14035096863582374] and 1 + 1/(2*kappa_E) >= 114062441973/25000000000 = 4.56249767892 exactly. checks.py is dependency-free standard-library Python; checks-output.txt is the complete transcript of one execution (exit code 0, ALL CHECKS PASSED).
